title: First AI-assisted game: my credit-cost breakdown—and what should I optimize next?
author: LevitizedLife_games
selftext:
Chocolate Prospecting Co. is open for business! 🍪

Play now → https://run.world/levitizedlife/chocolate-prospecting-co

This was an AI-assisted project, not a one-click generation workflow. I used AI primarily for \[coding help / early concept exploration / asset ideation / marketing copy\]. I came up with the ideas and gameplay mechanics as well as fine tuned the parameters myself through testing about 70 versions.  I trimed scope due to a contest deadline, but i am happy with the result from $12 of codex GPT-6 astra credits using the $100 monthly plan and estimating from weekly percentage used.  It took several hours of my time over two days, mostly during dead time where i could just send a quick prompt to continue building my game... waiting in line at the store, waiting for the microwave to finish,  etc.  Am i optimizing ai right?  I don't make money from this game, no ads, and I plan on building more free STEM games using ai. 

Play on your phone or computer. I’d love your feedback!

✅ Mine the fastest or with the most profit to join the leaderboard

✅ Design your own cookie

✅ Challenge friends to see who’s the best prospector

\#ChocolateProspectingCo #LevitizedLife
